name: MCPAudit
install:
set -eu
python3 -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check --user 'uv==0.12.12'
export PATH="$(python3 -m site --user-base)/bin:$PATH"
uv python install 3.11.15
test "$(uv --version | awk '{print $2}')" = "0.12.12"
uv sync --dev --locked --python 3.11.15
uv run mcp-audit --version
uv run ruff --version
uv run pytest --version
